subtitulo: Todos los domingos íbamos a la playa.
regla: Ir is irregular in the imperfect: iba, ibas, iba, íbamos, iban. Only nosotros has an accent (íbamos). It is one of only three irregular verbs in the imperfect, with ser and ver.

bloques.texto: **Ir** (_to go_) is one of only **three irregular verbs** in the imperfect (with **ser** and **ver**).
Its forms look like -ar endings on a tiny stem: **ib-** + **-a, -as, -a, -amos, -an**.
Only **íbamos** has a written accent. **Yo** and **él** share the form **iba**.
Use it for where you **used to go** (habits) and for where you **were going** when something happened.
Tip: _I used to go_ = **iba**. English **would** for a past habit (_every summer we would go…_) is also **íbamos**, never the conditional.

lista.es: Todos los domingos ==íbamos== a la playa.
lista.en: Every Sunday we used to go to the beach.

lista.es: De chavo ==iba== a surfear antes de la escuela.
lista.en: As a teenager I used to go surfing before school.

lista.es: ¿==Ibas== al gimnasio cuando vivías en el centro?
lista.en: Did you use to go to the gym when you lived downtown?

lista.es: Mi papá ==iba== al trabajo en camión.
lista.en: My dad used to go to work by bus.

lista.es: Los veranos ==íbamos== a Ensenada con mis primos.
lista.en: In the summers we would go to Ensenada with my cousins.

lista.es: Mis amigos ==iban== al mercado los sábados.
lista.en: My friends used to go to the market on Saturdays.

lista.es: Cuando me llamaste, ==iba== en el carro.
lista.en: When you called me, I was in the car.

filas.t: De niño fui a la playa todos los domingos.
De niño iba a la playa todos los domingos.

lista.texto: The preterite: [[5107|ir and ser in the preterite]].
The other two irregulars: [[5088|ser]] and [[5268|ver in the imperfect]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _We used to go to the beach every Saturday._
lista.r: Íbamos a la playa todos los sábados.

lista.p: In Spanish: _Where did you (tú) use to go after class?_
Fix it: _Mis primos ivan a Rosarito._
